g.text: Temperature follows a strong annual cycle (mean July 22.7 °C vs January 2.6 °C) with daily swings of several degrees; the wettest 10 minutes (26.7 mm, 17 Aug 2024 14:40 UTC) came in a short
burst during which air temperature fell by about 12.2 °C.
Data: GeoSphere Austria, klima-v2-10min, station 105 (CC BY 4.0). All times UTC.
Wien Hohe Warte, 10-minute air temperature and precipitation, 2020-2024
